apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 187 adds immersive mode with status bar hiding and double-tap reveal/hide, a GeForce NOW-style outlined controller preset whose center gamepad opens stream controls, optional session battery HUD metrics, and a local Sessions page with duration, battery readings/change and stream settings. Includes the clean Metal 4 display handoff, 2560×1080 near-native MetalFX upscaling, triple buffering/120 FPS configuration and vibration/controller/Mobile Game changes. iPhone simulator: 211 passed, one skip. iPad status bar/navigation: two passed. Unsigned KravaSigner build; physical gameplay gestures/controller and real session battery checks remain pending.
